verses.text: Mamin Jehová Te ay ip, ko Diosal ach a onh yinhtil onh winhaj Jacob, nakot winhaj David yet' syaelal. Nakot sti' winh ix yak' t'ayach ayik ix yalan winh:
Manh ol in och t'a yol in pat, manh ol in ek'laj jichan t'a sat in ch'at,
manh ol in mutz'laj in sat, manh ol ochlaj numnaj jab'ok in wayanh
ayik manto in b'o junok kajnub' b'aj skajnaj Jehová ko Diosal Te ay yip a onh yinhtil onh winhaj Jacob, xchikan winh.
Ha t'a Efrata ix kab' yab'ixal te' skaxail strato Dios, haxo t'a yol lum smakb'en winhaj Jaar ix ilchaj te' kuuj.
Koyek t'a stemplo Jehová, haxo ta' tzonh emek kuman t'a yichanh.
Mamin Jehová, kotanh t'a a kajnub' aynhej eq'ui. Kotanh yet' te' skaxail a trato, haton b'aj scheklajel a poder.
Aokab' wach'il sb'eyb'alej heb' a sakerdote. Elokab' yaw heb' ikxo t'a tzalajk'olal.
Yuj tas alnakkan t'a winh a chekab' aj David, manh ik'el a sat t'a winh rey sik'b'ilel uuj.
Ach Jehová, ix ak'kan a ti' t'a winhaj David t'a sjichanil to manh ol a k'exlaj tas ix ala', ayik ix alan icha tik: Ha junok uninal ol wak'kanoch reyal a k'exulok.
Tato sk'anab'ajej in trato heb' inhtilal yet' tastak ol wal t'a heb', ol ochnhej heb' t'a a despacho t'a masanil tiempo, xa chi t'a winh.
Mamin Jehová, a ach ix a sik'kanel lum tzalan Sion yik tzach kajnaj ta', yujto icha chi' snib'ej a k'ool.
Ix alan icha tik: Haton jun tzalan tik b'aj in gana tzin kajnaji. Ol in kajnaj t'a lu'um yujto icha chi' ix aj schaan in k'ool.
Manh jantakok wael uk'el ol wak' t'a heb' ayek' kajan ta', ol wak'an b'ut'jok sk'ool heb' meb'a'.
Ol in kol heb' sakerdote. Axo heb' ol in k'anab'ajanok, ol wak' awajk'e heb' yuj tzalajk'olal.
Ha t'a Sion chi', ol wak'och jun yinhtilal winhaj David reyal. Ha winh sik'b'ilel wuuj, manhxa b'ak'uinh ol yaktej heb' yinhtilal winh yak'an reyal.
Ha heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'a winh ol wak'kan q'uixwelal heb'. Axo yopisio winh, ol wik'chaanh, xa chikan ach Jehová.
